import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.ticker as mtick
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True

0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True
"""

df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set up the visualization style
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid")
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))

# Create the bar plot

    hue='sex',

ax.set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12, labelpad=10)
ax.set_xticklabels(['First', 'Second', 'Third']) # Use full class names

# Format y-axis as percentages
ax.yaxis.set_major_formatter(mtick.PercentFormatter(xmax=1.0))
ax.set_ylim(0, 1.1)

                ha='center', va='center',
                xytext=(0, 9),
                textcoords='offset points',
                fontsize=11,
                color='black',
                fontweight='bold')

# Customize legend
ax.legend(title='Sex', frameon=False, loc='upper left')

# Remove unnecessary spines
